gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G3: A refusal, a 404, a timeout or a no_contact is THIS RUNNER'S ACCESS AT THAT INSTANT and is never a statement about ICSID, about UNCITRAL, about a proceeding, or about a document's existence. Binding on every row.
gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G5: Anything living in an HTML attribute or an href is invisible to this instrument, because the reducer strips tags before searching. A null under G5 licenses nothing.
gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G6: An undecoded HTML entity, or a U+200B or other zero-width character inside a literal, returns a clean find_matched:false INDISTINGUISHABLE from real absence. The hazard is proven live on this host, not theoretical, and 0824-O13 records that this host inserts U+200B in exactly the table region rows A, B and D probe.
gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G7: CORRECTED FORM, per 2026-08-26 close-out decision 3 on 0826-R7 sustained. THE PREVIOUS STATED MECHANISM ('because inter-token markup can break it') IS FALSIFIED FOR THE INTER-TOKEN CASE, WHICH IS THE COMMON CASE. The residual weakness of a space-containing literal is a SPAN-LENGTH effect, not a space effect: the longer the contiguous span a literal must match, the more markup positions can break it. It says SHORTEN THE LITERAL, not de-space it. Rows A (`Decisions`) and B (`Published`) are the corrected rule applied: single tokens, minimum span.
gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G9: FINAL-URL GATE. If final_url differs from url in any respect, the row is UNINTERPRETABLE as to the case designator: a redirect to a generic or different docket means the window describes some other page. Check final_url before reading any excerpt.
gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G10: A DOCUMENT DESIGNATION IS NOT THE TRIBUNAL'S CHARACTERISATION. A row that surfaces the title of a decision establishes that the title exists on that page and establishes nothing about what the decision held.
gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G13: A confirmation from a SINGLE page state is a confirmation from a single page state. Case name, designation, date and value contiguous in ONE window is the strong form; anything assembled ACROSS windows or page states is not.
gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G16: NO ROW IN THIS BATCH MAY FOUND AN ORDINAL, A COUNT, A DISPOSITION OR A HOLDING. Binding with special force on row E: whatever returns from the annulment section is A DOCKET STATEMENT AND A DATE, never a disposition and never a holding. Any git-history count stated anywhere today must carry its anchor commit and its exclusions.
gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G17: WINDOW-EDGE GATE, RESCOPED per 2026-08-26 close-out decision 4. The excerpt is a 400-character window whose left edge is placed at match_index - 100. `find_matched` is REDUCED-BODY-SCOPED - wider than window-scoped, narrower than page-scoped - because the reduction that strips tags is LOSSY, which is exactly why G5 and G6 survive as residues. A token lying within ~100 characters before the match is CUT FROM THE EXCERPT though not from the match test. No row may assert a PAGE-scoped absence from a REDUCED-BODY-scoped null.
gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G18: TAIL BRACKET. The relay prepends its own control at records[0]; the last row below is the TAIL control on the same neutral host. If head and tail agree on bytes and sha256, every content row sits inside a verified bracket and control_ok is not head-anchored. If they disagree, the run is bracketed-inconsistent and every row between them is read with that stated.
gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G20: BYTE-LENGTH EQUALITY IS NOT PAGE-STATE IDENTITY. This project now holds THREE ARB/23/3 page states - 46ccad7f4bcaee9a (2026-08-24), 9237e1ae360c7482 (2026-08-25) and e0c3d269fd723a4a (2026-08-26) - and ALL THREE ARE 94393 BYTES. THE THIRD INSTANCE STRENGTHENS THE GENERALISATION; IT DOES NOT VINDICATE THE GATE, WHICH WAS UNFALSIFIABLE ON THE DAY IT WAS WRITTEN (0826-B11 second limb, sustained). Binding on rows A, B, C and D.
